objective: Add one bounded non-destructive move.step.v1 skill that moves Hina a short owner-requested cardinal distance on a resettable Minecraft test server and reports success only after normalized position evidence verifies direction and distance.
non_goals: Do not add pathfinding, jumping, sprinting, parkour, combat, mining, placing, collection, crafting, storage, eating or fleeing.
Do not add LLM planning, model-selected actions, runtime skill registration, generated code, eval, shell or arbitrary Mineflayer plugins.
Do not navigate around obstacles or retry a blocked movement.
Do not auto-connect, auto-move or execute the skill from chat, vision, memory, viewer input or the widget.
Do not claim real-server success rate without an owner-provided resettable server.
contracts: The static registry contains only look.v1 and move.step.v1; both are versioned, non-destructive, one-attempt skills with fixed timeout and postcondition.
move.step.v1 accepts exactly direction north|east|south|west and distanceBlocks from 0.25 through 2.0; invalid or extra input fails before Mineflayer.
Movement requires online, non-emergency, player-present, on-ground and no-concurrent-skill preconditions.
The controller faces the fixed cardinal yaw, holds only forward, waits on bounded physics ticks and always clears controls in finally on success, block, timeout, disconnect or emergency stop.

Success requires normalized post-state displacement in the requested cardinal direction, minimum progress relative to distance and bounded lateral drift; resolved vendor promises or elapsed time alone never prove success.
Blocked, missing-ground, timeout, vendor, cancellation and verifier mismatch are stable bounded failures with zero retry.
Only the operator Dashboard can request move.step.v1 through the existing ephemeral-secret authenticated loopback boundary; widget/model/viewer cannot invoke it.
allowed_dependencies: Existing pinned Node.js, Electron, Vue and Mineflayer dependencies only; no new dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Registry tests prove exactly two immutable safe skills and reject unknown, malformed, excessive-distance or extra-field move requests.
Controller tests prove cardinal mapping, control clearing, direction/distance/lateral postcondition, blocked result, timeout and emergency/disconnect cancellation without retry.
Authenticated service and Desktop client tests prove one fixed move route with bounded exact-schema input and no POST retry.
Dashboard explains the movement limit and exposes direction plus distance only while online.
Minecraft tests, Desktop typecheck/build/tests, repository fast tests, module-brief validation, GitNexus scan and git diff check pass.
required_test_commands: uv run --frozen python -c "import json; from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator; schema=json.load(open('docs/schemas/module-brief.schema.json', encoding='utf-8')); brief=json.load(open('docs/modules/M09-S4-verified-step-movement-module-brief.json', encoding='utf-8')); Draft202012Validator(schema).validate(brief)"
